text.tspan: The front of the FALCON030 system includes LEDs for power, floppy disk access, and if an
optional hard disk is installed, hard disk access. See Figure 1.
The rear of the FALCON030 system contains connectors for the digital audio interface, stereo
jacks, SCSI II connector, monitor out/genlock, RF out, parallel port, serial port, LAN, reset
button, on/off switch, and AC input. See Figure 2.
